The family archive

About the archive

Every family has a history worth preserving.

How the archive works

The archive connects the Downard, Freestone, Lambson, and Peterson families through people, places, stories, and records. Original scans are preserved with the narratives where they first appeared.

How we describe evidence

Verified
Supported by an identifiable primary record or corroborating evidence.
Documented
Stated in an identifiable source. An excerpt is labeled as such.
Probable
Supported by clues and awaiting corroboration.
Unverified
A claim that still needs supporting records.
Conflicting
Sources give different accounts.
Research in progress
An open investigation with evidence still to locate.

Living relatives

Living relatives appear with limited information where they connect the family tree. The public search omits their profiles.

Corrections are tracked in the research notebook.
